mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_recruitment_identity (tenant_id, identity_type, identity_hash, referral_id, candidate_id, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{type}, #{hash}, #{referralId}, #{candidateId}, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE identity_id = identity_id
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_recruitment_identity SET candidate_id = #{candidateId}, update_by = #{operator} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND referral_id = #{referralId} AND candidate_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT requisition.dept_id FROM hr_candidate candidate JOIN hr_recruitment_requisition requisition ON requisition.id = candidate.requisition_id AND requisition.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND requisition.deleted = 0 WHERE candidate.id = #{candidateId} AND candidate.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.deleted = 0
